propositions: Ticking acceptance-criteria checkboxes does not invalidate a plan-review attestation because checkbox state is normalized out of the material basis before hashing

The fixed staleness message lists 'description/AC/file_impact/children' but AC is not a basis component and per-component fingerprints are not surfaced, preventing readers from identifying which input actually changed

Pre-330c attestations hashed raw description, causing false stale-material verdicts when checkboxes are toggled after signing because neither the normalized recompute nor the legacy grandfather can match
Staleness messages must name the specific differing component(s) with before/after counts from the signed manifest's additive material-part lines to replace the fixed list
Signing failures caused by relation-snapshot read errors must not advise sign-review, since re-signing re-hits the same unreadable read and needs a different remedy
